description: Image Description: The image shows a display of luggage on a wooden shelf in what appears to be a retail store. There are several suitcases of varying sizes and colors, primarily black and dark brown, arranged neatly in rows. Each suitcase has a visible brand logo (a shield-shaped emblem) and a label indicating its capacity, such as "20" or "50," likely referring to the size in inches or liters. Some suitcases have tags attached, including red promotional tags with pricing information
